messages:
sam: Heads-up — we started a staged rollout ~10m ago and seeing a sharp uptick in 5xx for hosted inference. Customers reporting timeouts and errors on /v1/generate.

maya: seeing it in dashboards too — 5xx rate jumped from ~0.3% to 5.8% for the US-West nodes. Latency p50 up 3x.

leo: any recent config flips? which flag was changed for the rollout?

sam: we toggled a routing selector (kernel-path-v2=true) scoped to the staged slice. deploy-bot: deploy 2026.03.17-2245 applied to slice=staged.

jin: adding logs — gateway returning 502 with upstream timeout and occasional 503 from model-pool. snippet: ```ERROR: upstream timeout after 10s: route=kernel-path-v2, req_id=abc123```

maya: this smells like the kernel path isn't compatible with the current model variants under the staged slice — KV cache misses + longer init -> timeouts.

sam: support-bot: opened ticket INC-2851 and a customer thread (links pasted). customers impacted: 7 orgs, a few billing webhooks failing with 5xx responses.

leo: can we pin traffic away from staged slice quickly? if we reweight slice to 0% it should amber-route to baseline.

ryan: I'll take rollout rollback. Planning: 1) scale down staged weight to 0 2) revert feature-flag key 3) restart a handful of gateways if needed. Executing now: `redwoodctl rollout set-weight --slice staged --weight 0`

deploy-bot: action: set-weight staged=0 by ryan @1736667920 — accepted.

maya: telemetry confirms immediate drop in 5xx in US-West, p50 returning to baseline. Keep monitoring for billing webhook retries though.

jin: note — some auth failures (401) popped up for retry flows while we were overloaded; recommend checking token cache TTL change in the same deploy.

sam: where did the flag come from? I traced it to a canary manifest that included both kernel-path-v2 and a prefetch-window shrink. Two changes combined likely created the perf regression.

leo: action items: (a) hold further kernel-path-v2 rollout, (b) reproduce locally with staged model set, (c) prepare a narrower canary patch with only kernel-path patched and no prefetch change.

ryan: logging rollback complete and traffic rebalanced by 1736667930. I'll coordinate handoff to eng-runtime for root cause postmortem.

support-bot: Customer-facing note template: "We observed transient 5xx responses between 22:45-22:50 UTC affecting inference calls. We rolled back the staged rollout and are monitoring; please retry or contact support with request IDs."

maya: I'm going to run the repro harness against kernel-path-v2 on a replicated staged stack — will post commands and failure trace in 10m.

sam: thanks — also tagging billing team for webhook retries (cc @leo). Let's keep this thread for rollback coordination and make a new postmortem thread after RCA. :thumbsup:
